# ValueScope

> A deterministic DCF (discounted cash flow) valuation engine for stocks.
> Primary interface: an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server any AI client can
> call. Secondary interface: a web console for manual analysis at
> https://valuescope.app. Same input always produces the same output; the
> calling AI plays the analyst (researches and reasons about assumptions),
> the engine does the math.

## MCP server (recommended)

- Endpoint: https://mcp.valuescope.app/mcp (streamable HTTP)
- Setup guide: https://valuescope.app/mcp
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add valuescope --transport http https://mcp.valuescope.app/mcp`
- Claude web/mobile: Settings -> Connectors -> add custom connector with the endpoint URL
- One tool, `run_dcf`, two phases: call bare for a baseline valuation +
  per-parameter historical ranges + an analyst guide; then call again with
  reasoned assumptions for the final valuation (intrinsic value, value bridge,
  forecast table, sensitivity matrix, reverse DCF).
- An MCP prompt `dcf` surfaces a one-command workflow in supporting clients.

## Markets

- A-shares (600519.SS / 000333.SZ) and Hong Kong (0700.HK): completely free,
  no key needed.
- US (AAPL) and Japan (7203.T): 3 free trial valuations per day served by the
  server; beyond that bring your own FMP key via the `X-FMP-Key` request
  header or a `fmp_api_key` tool parameter. Discounted FMP signup (coupon
  code `valuescope`):
  https://site.financialmodelingprep.com/pricing-plans?couponCode=valuescope

## Other pages

- Web console: https://valuescope.app (DCF, relative valuation, 4-dimension
  scoring, portfolio tracker)
- Stock pages: https://valuescope.app/stock/<ticker>
- Source (AGPL-3.0): https://github.com/alanhewenyu/ValueScope

All valuations are deterministic model outputs for research reference only —
not investment advice.
